description_target.target_text: extrapolate the next panel in the growing-shape sequence

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Panels (3 stacked vertically when h divides into 7-11 rows, else 5
 ;; or 3 across) animate a payload shape moving over a constant
 ;; backdrop. Take the last two panels holding the MAIN payload color,
 ;; read the step between them, and extrapolate one more step onto the
 ;; next blank panel: pure growth extends along the bbox drift, a rigid
 ;; move repeats (additions doubled ahead). A far-apart horizontal pair
 ;; instead fills the shape's column span solid and dots the companion
 ;; color down its center column.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define vertical?
       (and (zero? (modulo h 3))
            (member? (quotient h 3) (list 7 8 9 10 11))))
     (define ph (if vertical? (quotient h 3) h))
     (define pw (if vertical?
                    w
                    (if (zero? (modulo w 5)) (quotient w 5) (quotient w 3))))
     (define (panel-at r0 c0)
       (build-grid ph pw (r c) (at g (+ r0 r) (+ c0 c))))
     (define panels
       (if vertical?
           (for/list ((r0 (range 0 h ph))) (panel-at r0 0))
           (for/list ((c0 (range 0 w pw))) (panel-at 0 c0))))
     (define (colors-of p) (remove-duplicates (map third (grid-cells p))))
     (define common  ;; backdrop colors present in every panel
       (for/fold ((acc (colors-of (first panels)))) ((p (rest panels)))
         (filter (lambda (x) (member x acc)) (colors-of p))))
     (define payload
       (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v common)))
               (remove-duplicates (apply append (map colors-of panels)))))
     (define (count-in p color)
       (count-if (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) color)) (grid-cells p)))
     (define main
       (first (sort payload
                    (lambda (a b) (> (count-in (first panels) a)
                                     (count-in (first panels) b))))))
     (define selected  ;; panels where the main color appears
       (filter (lambda (idx) (> (count-in (list-ref panels idx) main) 0))
               (range 0 (length panels))))
     (define ai (list-ref selected (- (length selected) 2)))
     (define bi (list-ref selected (- (length selected) 1)))
     (define A (list-ref panels ai))
     (define B (list-ref panels bi))
     (define selected-colors
       (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v common)))
               (remove-duplicates (append (colors-of A) (colors-of B)))))
     (define (blank? p)
       (not (for/or ((v payload)) (> (count-in p v) 0))))
     (define base  ;; the panel the next frame lands on
       (let ((after (filter (lambda (idx) (blank? (list-ref panels idx)))
                            (range (+ bi 1) (length panels)))))
         (if (empty? after) B (list-ref panels (first after)))))
     (define clean-base  ;; base with stray payload scrubbed to backdrop
       (let ((fill (mode-list (filter (lambda (v) (member v common))
                                      (map third (grid-cells base))))))
         (build-grid ph pw (r c)
                     (if (member (at base r c) payload)
                         fill
                         (at base r c)))))
     (define (subset-cells? a b) (for/and ((p a)) (member p b)))
     (define (remove-cells a b)
       (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p b))) a))
     (define (shift-cells cells dr dc)
       (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) ph pw))
               (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) dr) (+ (second p) dc)))
                    cells)))
     (define (bbox-cells cells)
       (list (min-of first cells) (max-of first cells)
             (min-of second cells) (max-of second cells)))
     (define (infer-shift a b)  ;; smallest rigid move taking a into b
       (let ((cands (filter identity
                            (for*/list ((dr (range -4 5)) (dc (range -4 5)))
                              (and (not (and (zero? dr) (zero? dc)))
                                   (subset-cells? (shift-cells a dr dc) b)
                                   (= (length (shift-cells a dr dc))
                                      (length a))
                                   (list (+ (abs dr) (abs dc)) dr dc
                                         (shift-cells a dr dc)))))))
         (if (empty? cands) #f (pick-min cands first))))
     (define (next-cells ca cb)  ;; extrapolate frame B -> next frame
       (cond ((empty? ca) cb)
             ((subset-cells? ca cb)  ;; growth: extend along bbox drift
              (let* ((added (remove-cells cb ca))
                     (ba (bbox-cells ca)) (bb (bbox-cells cb))
                     (dr (cond ((< (first bb) (first ba)) -1)
                               ((> (second bb) (second ba)) 1)
                               (else 0)))
                     (dc (cond ((< (third bb) (third ba)) -1)
                               ((> (fourth bb) (fourth ba)) 1)
                               (else 0))))
                (remove-duplicates (append cb (shift-cells added dr dc)))))
             (else  ;; rigid move (+ additions carried twice as far)
              (let ((move (infer-shift ca cb)))
                (if move
                    (let* ((dr (second move)) (dc (third move))
                           (added (remove-cells cb (fourth move))))
                      (remove-duplicates
                       (append (shift-cells cb dr dc) added
                               (shift-cells added (* 2 dr) (* 2 dc)))))
                    cb)))))
     (if (and (not vertical?) (> (- bi ai) 1))
         (let* ((bb (bbox-cells (cells-of-color B main)))
                (other (find-first (lambda (v) (not (= v main)))
                                   selected-colors))
                (center-col (mode-list (map second (cells-of-color B other))))
                (filled (for*/fold ((out clean-base))
                                   ((r (range 1 (- ph 1)))
                                    (c (range (third bb) (+ (fourth bb) 1))))
                          (set-cell out r c main))))
           (for/fold ((out filled)) ((r (range 1 (- ph 1) 2)))
             (set-cell out r center-col other)))
         (let ((plans  ;; biggest shape painted first (others overlay)
                (sort (map (lambda (color)
                             (let ((cells (next-cells
                                           (cells-of-color A color)
                                           (cells-of-color B color))))
                               (list (length cells) color cells)))
                           selected-colors)
                      (lambda (a b) (> (first a) (first b))))))
           (for/fold ((out clean-base)) ((plan plans))
             (recolor-cells out (third plan) (second plan))))))))
